Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all compounds in document CHEMBL2163248. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
